notes.title: Darknet Update and Bundle
notes.content:
Darknet has just been updated to include a dedicated Oculus Rift version with Touch support!

Also, a new game has been added alongside Darknet on the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/4297/The_VR_Strategy_Bundle_Get_4_great_VR_games/]VR Strategy Bundle[/url]. If you like Darknet, be sure to check it out!

notes.title: 7/13/17 Patch!
notes.content:
Darknet has just received it's first patch!

This includes an adjustment to allow for both seated AND standing play in VR mode, plus the addition of haptic feedback.

In the non-VR mode, several bugs have been fixed, including some that led to accidentally quitting or switching languages, losing mouse focus, and eating up unlimited CPU time.
